structured.reason: The description contains statements that address known review complaints in a minimizing way, which the criterion counts as negative. (1) "Trim them to fit your eye shape, then apply and go." This addresses the reviewer complaint that the lashes are too long and need to be measured and cut before wearing ("Just need to measure them and cut them before you wear them"; "they are too long"; "these were to much"). (2) "The lightweight, soft design keeps comfort in mind through a long day." This responds to the reviewer note that the lashes are "a just a little bit heavy," and the reassurance implies a comfort concern exists. The description also says "a bolder option for special nights," which implies these lashes are intense and not for everyday use, a mild caveat. Under the strict standard, any reassurance that minimizes a review complaint fails the description.
